root_cause.text: The function `ras_core_ras_interrupt_detected()` fails to validate that `ras_core` is non-NULL before dereferencing `ras_core->dev` in its error logging path, causing a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a NULL check `if (ras_core && ras_core->dev)` before the `RAS_DEV_ERR(ras_core->dev, ...)` call, which previously accessed `ras_core->dev` unconditionally after the initial guard condition (which only checked `ras_core->sys_fn`) was false. The CVE description confirms the dereference occurs when `ras_core` is NULL.
